headline: China Keeps Benchmark Loan Prime Rates Unchanged for 18th Month
summary: The People's Bank of China left its benchmark lending rates unchanged, holding the one-year Loan Prime Rate at 3.0% and the five-year rate at 3.5%. The decision extends a multi-month hold on official policy rates.
why: The People's Bank of China sets the Loan Prime Rate monthly, influencing corporate and household borrowing costs throughout China's economy.
